description: REGRESSION (double rounding): Idaho Form 40 line 20 is a whole-dollar line. Taxable income of $4,877 is $66 over the $4,811 threshold, and 5.3% x 66 = 3.498 -> $3. Rounding to cents first (3.50) and then to dollars gave $4 — wrong for 276 of 55,189 taxable incomes, always overstating, on Idaho's MAIN rate.
